correctness.rationale: Full bitmask enumeration validates face predicates and face vectors for both twenty-vertex graphs. All 811,260 nonempty Hasse incidences are checked in complete acyclicity topological sorts. Signed integer Morse boundary recursion gives the displayed matrices, verified vanishing composition, unit minors proving primitive images, and independent full simplicial mod-two ranks. Degree classifications of low-dimensional sphere-wedge attaching maps, not homology alone, establish the integral homotopy types.

value.rationale: The first higher-independence/dissociation level of two canonical, equally sized cubic generalized Petersen graphs is a natural motivated topological comparison, not an arbitrary slicing. Their full integral homotopy types differ in dimension and sphere multiplicity, demonstrating information not determined by prior ordinary-independence calculations. Primitive boundary certificates exclude torsion and elevate the result above finite-field data; no downstream theorem is necessary for this exact natural classification.
